reviews.text: We were debating a pool for quite some time. We moved to a new home and decided to pull the trigger. We looked at three different pool companies, and Foley landed right in the middle. Everyone knows pools aren't cheap, so you want to know you get good design, and great customer service. From quoting to dig day and pool school, the entire process was really smooth. They kept us informed every step of the way. Some companies only deal with the pool, but Foley handles the fence repair, irrigation, and landscaping. I couldn't have asked for a better experience with so many nightmare stories out there about pool builds. Dillon our sales guy was a straight shooter, and great designer. He helped us articulate the vision for our backyard project. He walked us through all of the materials picking and made it frictionless. John the project manager stayed on top of every step, and was always stopping by to make sure everything was in order according to plan. These guys are top notch, and they have a wonderful team. I'd highly recommend giving them a call and letting them quote your project.
reviews.author: Brian and Lynette Tucker

reviews.text: This is our third time using Foley Pools, and we wouldn’t consider any other pool company. Foley has built a strong reputation in North Texas—and for good reason. Their service, professionalism, and quality are second to none. We’ve had the pleasure of working with Kevin, Dillon, and Tyler Foley over the years, and they are truly a class act. Exceptional experience from start to finish—highly recommend!
reviews.author: Cheri Zaberer

reviews.text: Had an excellent experience with Foley Pools. They were quick with the construction of our pool/spa project and new fence with sod. If any issues came up, they were on it. I would highly recommend them for your pool or backyard projects. Our pool tech Josh is wonderful and has done an excellent job with our service cleaning as well.
reviews.author: Erica Andrade

reviews.text: I want to express my deepest gratitude to Kevin and John for selling us our fantastic outdoor Oasis. Our pool maintenance guy, Josh, has been doing an outstanding job keeping our pool water crystal clear, just as we prefer. We highly recommend the Foleys team!
reviews.author: Sedrick Stubbs

reviews.text:
After moving back to the area this summer, our first stop was Foley to begin the process of building our second pool with them. The design process was just as smooth and painless the second time around. Dillon did an amazing job guiding us through every step.

During construction, John was fantastic to work with. Whenever any questions or issues arose, he was quick to explain the process or resolve them promptly.

Now that the pool is complete, Josh has been doing an incredible job keeping it sparkling clean. He is very polite and always checks in with us when we’re outside to see how we’re doing and if there’s anything else we need.

We would absolutely recommend Foley to anyone who asks. While we hope this is the last pool we build, if we ever do it again, Foley will be our first choice.
reviews.author: Sean Kelley

reviews.text: Great Job Foley Pool. Aaron was a great. He came up with our backyard design quick after I told him what I wanted. Our yard was small and always got muddy  when it rains. After few years our grass barley grew due to so much trees behind our house. I  wanted extended slab with outdoor grill and fire pit and artifical grass and a place for a hot tub this winter. They were able to complete my back yard in less then 2 months. The team was great. Got a new fence as well and knocked down my rear fence and extend my yard about 5 feet bigger. Everyone loves our back yard now. We can host parties and not worry about getting our shoes muddy after the rain and no worrying about trying to get my grass to grow.  Thanks to your team for the great work of transforming our yard to a place we can have great memories.
reviews.author: anthony Martinez

reviews.text: We are very happy with our Foley pool!  We really enjoyed working with Dillon & John as they helped us design & build the pool.  It was a great process overall!  They were very patient with all our questions and the pool looks beautiful! Josh also does an excellent job maintaining our pool every week. Knowing he’s coming by to check everything and keep our pool running perfectly has been a huge stress relief for us.
reviews.author: Jennifer Grabham

reviews.text:
We had a great experience with our pool remodel with Foley pools. Aaron P. with Foley pools came out and discussed what our ideas were, what we wanted, and took measurements of our current pool. The pool was in bad shape and had tiles popping off as well as plaster getting worn out. Aaron drew up some 3D plans showing the idea of what we wanted. We discussed our budget, timeline, and selected tiles and coping at their office in Prosper. I was a very particular client because I’m a former Architect and had a specific idea in mind for the fountain. Aaron worked with me to come up with a great design. The project started on May 19th and was done 24 days later on June 12th. Communication with our project manager John S. and Aaron was great throughout the project. All the subcontractors were skilled at their specific parts of the project and were friendly and respectful. We are so pleased with how well the pool turned out. Everyone that sees it is amazed at the transformation to our backyard in such a short amount of time. I am very confident in my recommendation of Foley pools! They did a fantastic job! (see the before and after pics) For reference these are the tile, stone, and plaster selections we made:
Waterline tile Aquabella: Abyss series AY-621 Atlantis 6x6
Waterline Accent tile every 5’: Fujiwa: Flora Beliz 6x6 decorative (white with blue starburst)
Fountain wall: Aquabella-Voyage series VG-846 narrows 1x2
Stone wall: Buff Lueders Chopstone
Coping and wall cap: Buff Lueders cap, chip face
Pool plaster color: Wet Edge - Signature Matrix: Brilliant Blue
reviews.author: Ingrid F

data.summary: Significant platform discrepancy raises red flags. Sampled Google reviews appear overly positive and uniform, lacking constructive criticism. However, the reviews contain authentic-sounding details and the company has a long history. The low Yelp and Houzz ratings suggest real customer dissatisfaction exists but may not be reflected on Google.
fake_signals: All sampled Google reviews are 5-star with no negative feedback
Google reviews mention many of the same staff names (Kevin, Dillon, John, Josh, Aaron)
Lack of any critical details or minor issues in sampled 5-star reviews
authentic_signals: Specific project details mentioned (remodels, new builds, fences, sod)
Mentions of long-term relationships and repeat business
complaint_patterns: Cannot be determined from provided data
data.discrepancy_explanation: Major discrepancy between Google (4.5/553) and Yelp (2.4/60). Houzz rating (1.8/4) is also very low. This suggests potential review manipulation on Google or that negative experiences are concentrated on specific platforms.
